secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (Settings → API) for the optional cloud sync of vistorias. The app runs fully offline without it.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/publishable key (Settings → API) for the optional cloud sync. Safe in the browser bundle; RLS enforces access.

secrets.name: VITE_NETLIFY_TOKEN
secrets.description: Netlify personal access token, used to publish a report (laudo) as a public link from the app. Optional.
